newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Oct industrial output up 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Oct industrial output up 11.7 pct.

text.p: Argentina's industrial output in October was 11.7 percent higher than October 1995 and up 4.6 percent from September 1996, the independent FIEL consultants said in a preliminary report.
In the first 10 months of the year, industrial production was up 3.7 percent over the comparable period last year.

Nine percent of the firms polled by FIEL described the demand trend as encouraging, 79 percent as average and 12 percent as discouraging. FIEL described the demand for durable consumer goods as particularly encouraging.

After stocks had run down in September, industrial firms replenished their inventory to what FIEL said was normal levels. Fourteen percent of firms said their stocks were high, 75 percent said they were average and 11 percent low.
Use of installed capacity rose 1.2 percentage points from September, reaching 77.2 percent.
FIEL said it would release its revised October data on Nov 25.
